data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2022 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 375.528m. The year saw net favourable prior-year reserve reassessments (a reported net surplus of GBP 30.83m) driven primarily by favourable claims development and reserve releases, notably on 2019 and prior years (reported as contributing GBP 27.6m to underwriting profit, predominantly across Property and Motor). The Syndicate also experienced current-year catastrophe and geopolitical-related provisions (Hurricane Ian, Winter Storm Elliot, Sydney Floods and exposures from the Ukraine War) which increased the claims ratio in 2022. The report does not disclose a single aggregate GROSS prior-year development figure; the only explicit prior-year movement statement is expressed on a net basis.
raw_causal_phrases: a surplus of GBP 30,830,000 (2021: surplus of GBP 16,021,000) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
Prior year reserve releases on the 2019 and prior years of account contributed GBP 27.6 million to underwriting profit (2021: GBP 17.3 million), predominantly across the Property & Motor division.
The Syndicate was impacted by provisions for potential exposures arising from the Ukraine War, in addition to Hurricane Ian, Winter Storm Elliot and Sydney Floods.

data.data_quality_notes: The report explicitly states net prior-year reserve movements (net surplus GBP 30.83m) and net prior-year releases (GBP 27.6m on 2019 and prior) but does not disclose an explicit aggregate GROSS prior-year movement in a single line. A gross prior-year development figure could not be reliably located in the movement notes; a gross claims development triangle is present but the tabular format in the PDF is ambiguous for automated extraction. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is left null. The opening and closing gross claim reserve balances are explicit and captured.
